title: Leg — one played card in a Cornucopia atelier (FR-007, FR-012)
description: Each leg is persisted as its own JSON file named leg-{NNN}-{playerSlug}.json inside the atelier folder. Written with validation=PENDING and precisions=[] when the card is played, updated in place as precisions arrive, and finally flipped to VALIDATED or REJECTED after the vote.

cardName.description: Name of the played card (placeholder deck in this increment)

scenario.description: Threat scenario evoked by the player

explanation.description: The player's explanation of the scenario

precisions.description: Precisions added by the other players and 'Je sais' answers to their questions (FR-009, FR-010). Empty list when the card is first played.

validation.description: PENDING when written, then VALIDATED iff strictly more than half of the voters (all players except the card player) answered yes, else REJECTED (FR-012, R-006)
